doc.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Three years of study with Roy Knapp and Chicago band-hopping
summary: He studied with Knapp for about three years, using trips to hear Calloway, Krupa, Dorsey, Ellington and Basie.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: We’re getting a little ahead of ourselves if you’re already talking about being with the Goodman band, so let’s back up. You’re still in high school. You’re studying. You’ve been studying with Roy Knapp. How long did you study with Roy?

With Roy Knapp? I studied with him for about three years. I gained a lot of knowledge, and it gave me a chance to go to Chicago, take my lesson from him, then stay over a day or two, and like I said before, go to catch Cab Calloway, Gene Krupa, Tommy Dorsey, Duke, Basie. I caught all of them.
